subject: general process for organizing regression parameter output from multiple .out files

messages.author: 3945e838ed92472f
messages.subject: general process for organizing regression parameter output from multiple .out files
parts:
Hello all, 
I've recently learned the wonders of createModels and now have a folder containing > 100 .out files. I've used readModels (" ", what="parameters", recursive = TRUE) to combine these in R, but would like to create a simplified summary text document containing the filename and unstandardized regression estimates from each of these models. 

I've tried to use paramExtract but am not having luck:

> d <- allModelParameters$results$parameters
> paramExtract(d, "regression")
Error in sum(index) : invalid 'type' (list) of argument

Would anyone provide guidance on completing this seemingly ordinary task? 

Thanks, 

Nick 

Nicholas Bishop, PhD

Assistant Professor

Family and Child Development

School of Family and Consumer Sciences

Texas State University - San Marcos

messages.subject: Re: general process for organizing regression parameter output from multiple .out files
parts:
The challenge is that there may be many subsections within the parameters element, such as unstandardized, stdyx.standardized, and so on. As a result, you probably want to think about looping over models and pulling out the data.frame of interest from each. I would also tag the results by model so that you don't get confused about the origin of the parameter estimates. Here's an example:

combined <- do.call(dplyr::bind_rows, sapply(1:length(All_Output), function(m) { 
      df <- All_Output[[m]]$parameters$unstandardized
      df$model <- names(All_Output)[m]
      return(df)
    }))

where All_Output is a list of models returned by readModels.

Hope this helps!
Michael
